newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London flat after weak Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London flat after weak Tokyo.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were steady to slightly lower on Monday after a weaker close in Tokyo hit sentiment, dealers said.
The Nikkei/Ise 50 index in London was down 4.02 points at 1,435.86 after the Nikkei 225 in Tokyo ended 0.64 percent lower on arbitrage-linked selling after last week's major gains.
Dealers said trading was quiet, with investors continuing to fret about government policies.
Market holidays in the U.S. and some European countries hit business while Wednesday's U.S. Federal Open Market Committee meeting was keeping investors cautious.
"The market gave back some of Friday's gains and there's still some selling interest in the market," one dealer said.
Traders noted some continued pressure on Toyota Motor Corp., which lost in Tokyo on profit-taking despite an optimistic forecast for the current year.
